title: Controls.
officialText:
Direct-fired make-up air heaters shall be equipped with airflow-sensing devices, safety shutoff devices, operating
temperature controls and thermally actuated temperature limit controls in accordance with the terms of their listing.
SECTION FGC 612
RECIRCULATING DIRECT-FIRED INDUSTRIAL AIR
HEATERS
